skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this image into a 10-second animated video clip with motion effects —...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video Generator Unrestricted.
- Instantly turn uploaded still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF up to 200MB) into animated video clips with automatic cloud processing.
- No need for local software; supports simple setup with free credits on sign-up.
- Supports quick edit, batch, and iterative workflows, including video, audio, and text overlays.
- Exports high-quality MP4 (1080p by default) and other major formats for easy sharing across platforms.
